description: Median spot price of up to 50 coins across Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, OKX and Bybit in usd/usdt/eur/btc, with per-venue prices, 24h change, volume and spread. ids: any CoinGecko id (~23k), ticker, CoinPaprika id or contract address (base:0x..., solana:<mint>); DEX-only tokens priced via DefiLlama/DexScreener. Unknown ids: 404, not charged. Price: $0.003 USDC per call, paid with x402 on Base.

chain.description: Chain for bare 0x addresses: base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, avalanche (default: base, then ethereum)

ids.description: Comma-separated, max 50: CoinGecko ids (bitcoin,virtual-protocol), tickers (BTC,ETH; any CoinGecko-listed ticker, largest market cap wins), CoinPaprika ids (btc-bitcoin) or contract addresses with chain (base:0x..., ethereum:0x..., solana:<mint>)

vs.description: usd (default), usdt, eur or btc; comma-separated for several (usd,eur)

name: prices_token_price
